SELECT 
    races.year AS year,
    constructorStandings.points AS points
FROM 
    races
JOIN 
    results ON races.raceId = results.raceId
JOIN 
    drivers ON results.driverId = drivers.driverId
JOIN 
    constructorStandings ON results.raceId = constructorStandings.raceId
WHERE 
    drivers.forename = 'Lewis' AND drivers.surname = 'Hamilton'
ORDER BY 
    races.year ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    r.year AS year,
    SUM(r.points) AS total_points
FROM 
    races r
JOIN 
    drivers d ON r.year = d.year
JOIN 
    results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
WHERE 
    d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'
    AND res.position = 1
GROUP BY 
    r.year
ORDER BY 
    r.year ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
  ((balance_of_date_A - balance_of_date_B) / balance_of_date_B) * 100 AS increase_rate
FROM
  (SELECT balance AS balance_of_date_A
   FROM trans
   WHERE date = '1993-03-22' AND account = (SELECT account_id FROM loan WHERE date = '1993-07-05' AND status = 'approved')) AS A,
  (SELECT balance AS balance_of_date_B
   FROM trans
   WHERE date = '1998-12-27' AND account = (SELECT account_id FROM loan WHERE date = '1993-07-05' AND status = 'approved')) AS B;

WITH loan_details AS (
    SELECT loan_id, account_id, date
    FROM loan
    WHERE date = '1993-07-05'
),
account_balance_changes AS (
    SELECT trans.account_id, trans.date, trans.balance
    FROM trans
    WHERE trans.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM loan_details)
),
balance_diff AS (
    SELECT 
        ab1.account_id,
        (ab1.balance - ab2.balance) / ab2.balance * 100.0 AS increase_rate
    FROM account_balance_changes ab1
    JOIN account_balance_changes ab2
        ON ab1.account_id = ab2.account_id
        AND ab1.date = '1993-03-22'
        AND ab2.date = '1998-12-27'
)
SELECT increase_rate
FROM balance_diff;

SELECT 
  ((balance_of_date_A - balance_of_date_B) / balance_of_date_B) * 100 AS increase_rate
FROM
  (SELECT balance AS balance_of_date_A
   FROM trans
   WHERE date = '1993-03-22' AND account = (SELECT account_id FROM loan WHERE date = '1993-07-05' AND status = 'approved')) AS a,
  (SELECT balance AS balance_of_date_B
   FROM trans
   WHERE date = '1998-12-27' AND account = (SELECT account_id FROM loan WHERE date = '1993-07-05' AND status = 'approved')) AS b;

WITH client_loan AS (
    SELECT loan.account_id, loan.date
    FROM loan
    WHERE loan.date = '1993-07-05'
    ORDER BY loan.date
    LIMIT 1
),
account_balance AS (
    SELECT trans.account_id, trans.date, trans.balance
    FROM trans
    WHERE trans.account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM client_loan)
)
SELECT 
    ((SELECT balance FROM account_balance WHERE date = '1993-03-22') - 
     (SELECT balance FROM account_balance WHERE date = '1998-12-27')) / 
    (SELECT balance FROM account_balance WHERE date = '1998-12-27') * 100 AS increase_rate;

SELECT 
    Player.player_name, 
    CAST(DATE_DIFF(CURRENT_DATE, Player.birthday, 'SECOND') / 31536000 AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM 
    Player
JOIN 
    Player_Attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id
WHERE 
    Player_Attributes.sprint_speed >= 97
    AND Player_Attributes.date BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2015-12-31';

SELECT 
    Player.player_name, 
    FLOOR(DATETIME('now', 'localtime') - strftime('%s', Player.birthday)) / (365.25) AS age
FROM 
    Player
JOIN 
    Player_Attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id
WHERE 
    Player_Attributes.sprint_speed >= 97
    AND strftime('%Y', Player_Attributes.date) BETWEEN '2013' AND '2015';

SELECT 
    Player.player_name, 
    ROUND((strftime('%s', 'now') - strftime('%s', Player.birthday)) / 31536000) AS age
FROM 
    Player
JOIN 
    Player_Attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id
WHERE 
    Player_Attributes.sprint_speed >= 97
    AND strftime('%Y', Player_Attributes.date) BETWEEN '2013' AND '2015';

SELECT 
    Player.player_name, 
    CAST(DATETIME() - Player.birthday AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM 
    Player
JOIN 
    Player_Attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id
WHERE 
    Player_Attributes.sprint_speed >= 97
    AND Player_Attributes.date BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2015-12-31';

SELECT q.position AS fastest_lap_number
FROM qualifying q
JOIN results r ON q.driverId = r.driverId
JOIN races ra ON q.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE ra.year = 2009
  AND r.position = 1;  -- Assuming 'position' in results table indicates the champion's position

SELECT q.position AS fastest_lap_number
FROM qualifying q
JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN results res ON q.driverId = res.driverId AND q.raceId = res.raceId
WHERE r.year = 2009
  AND res.position = 1; -- Assuming 'position' in results table indicates the champion's position

SELECT q.position AS fastest_lap_number
FROM qualifying q
JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2009
  AND q.position = (
    SELECT MIN(q2.position)
    FROM qualifying q2
    JOIN races r2 ON q2.raceId = r2.raceId
    WHERE r2.year = 2009
  );

SELECT q.position AS fastest_lap_number
FROM qualifying q
JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN results res ON q.driverId = res.driverId AND q.raceId = res.raceId
WHERE r.year = 2009
  AND res.points = (SELECT MAX(points) FROM results WHERE raceId = q.raceId);
